prompts.name: conduct
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated production 2D Unity game neuron sprite. Match the attached golden neuron reference: luminous fine golden-amber neural fibers, elegant organic membrane, warm white pinprick nucleus, tiny cyan signal pinpoints, delicate tapering processes. Real transparent alpha background. Orthographic front view in the XY plane, perfectly centered nucleus at exactly 50% x, 50% y for rotating around the pivot. Square canvas. Keep the whole silhouette inside the central 76% of the canvas, with clear 12% transparent margins. Soma fills approximately 30% of canvas width; peripheral processes are SHORT, extending at most to the 12% margin, so it reads clearly at 80px on a dense hexagonal grid. Strong recognizable central body silhouette is critical. Moderate gold emission only along fibers; dark amber interiors retain readable structure. No broad opaque orange haze. NO diagram, NO letters, NO arrows, NO labels, NO hexagon frame, NO checkerboard, NO background, NO ground shadow, NO mechanical parts, NO thick glass tentacles, NO detached particles. Single sprite only, not a sheet. Keep gold palette common to the set; shape differentiates types. CONDUCTOR: the soma is a narrow vertically elongated spindle / oval (not a circle), tapered top and bottom. Exactly ONE clear outgoing axon pointing straight UP at 12 o'clock, slender and gold, with tiny distal branching. A much shorter dim fine dendritic tuft may trail below; no lateral long processes. Nucleus exactly centered in canvas. The upper process is dominant and must point straight up.
